$comment: The hand-made part of the kiosk text registry; gen_registry.py reads it with the sources and writes kiosk_text_registry.json + report.md. Per text: key, group, label (Hebrew, ≤ 40), max, kind (T title 60 / B button 30 / L short label 24 / S subtitle-hint 100 / D body 200 — the max's base; never below 1.5× the longest default, never above 200), placeholders (names in the Android resource's positional order), android (the resources this key overrides), web (m.t() / LIVE keys it replaces), shownWhen, en (only where no English exists), enOverride (+ why). sources.webScreens: the web screens scanned for m.t() / t() keys no text maps (warned unless in webIgnore). scope: the staff strings left out, the new strings taken though not referenced yet, leaveOut (referenced but left out by hand, with why). autoKeyPrefixes / autoGroups: for a referenced string with no entry here (NO META). notes: copied into report.md.

webIgnore.untitledMessage: the preview's name for a message without a title (editor)
webIgnore.skippedService: the preview's note that the service screen is skipped (editor)
webIgnore.simulatePaid: the preview's "simulate an approved payment" button (editor)
webIgnore.quickNote1: sample quick note — the live kiosk passes the menu's own quick notes
webIgnore.quickNote2: sample quick note — the live kiosk passes the menu's own quick notes
webIgnore.quickNote3: sample quick note — the live kiosk passes the menu's own quick notes
webIgnore.poweredBy: "POWERED BY R2M POS" — the product's mark, not a business text
webIgnore.waitingTitle: the paired till waiting to become a kiosk (staff / setup)
webIgnore.waitingBody: the paired till waiting to become a kiosk (staff / setup)

notes: en.json does not exist in client/src/messages (the dashboard is Hebrew-only): English comes from values-en, else from the meta (listed above). The script reads en.json `kiosks.builtin` / `kiosks.preview` first if it ever appears.

`checkoutCta` ("לתשלום") has no placeholder; Android's fallback `kapp_checkout` ("לתשלום · %1$s") has one, so it is its own key `checkout` ({total}). Both platforms build "<checkoutCta> · <total>" when checkoutCta is set (KioskOrderScreens.kt, Details.tsx); the side panel (KioskCatalogParts.kt) uses `kapp_checkout` alone. `checkoutCta` is `"android": []`.
`voucherApplied` ("השובר נקלט", no placeholder) is not used by Android; Android's `kpay_voucher_applied` ("שובר #%1$d נקלט: %2$s") is the separate key `payVoucherApplied` ({number}, {amount}).

`helpText` overrides `kapp_help_body` (the long how-to) on Android, but its he.json default is the short line (= `kapp_help_short`, kept as `helpShort`); its English is written to match the Hebrew default (see the table above).
`payTitle`: he.json "תשלום" vs Android "תשלום באשראי"; English written as "Payment" to match the Hebrew default.

`cashSlipPending` overrides two Android texts today (the slip's `kpay_slip_pending` and the screen's `kpay_done_pending`, which adds "— הציגו את הפתק בקופה"); they differ in content, so `kpay_done_pending` is its own key `payDonePending`. Android may keep reading a configured `cashSlipPending` first for the screen line.

Merged: `noteTitle` = `ktx_note_title` + `kapp_notes` (the same "הערות למנה" / "Notes for the dish" in the sheet and in the note window). No other merges: same-text pairs on different screens (e.g. `ktx_step_pay` / `klay_step_pay`, `kapp_meal_step` / `klay_guided_step_of`, `kapp_cart_title` / `klay_basket_my_order`) stay separate keys so each screen / layout group is complete. `klay_step_pay` → `stepPayGuided` (stepPay is legacy), `klay_step_tip` → `stepTipShort`.

`kapp_search_hint`, `kapp_note_hint`, `kapp_service_title` and the rest of "Android strings left out" are not referenced in code, so they are not in the registry (e.g. `searchHint` maps only `ktx_search_hint`).

Slip and dietary strings are referenced outside ui/kiosk + domain/Kiosk*: data/repo/KioskBonService.kt, data/repo/KioskPayAtTill.kt (slips) and ui/common/DietaryMarks.kt (dietary) are scanned too (`sources.codeGlobs`). The klay_* strings are not referenced yet (new) and are taken by `scope.includeUnreferencedPrefixes`.
`kapp_day_0..6` are also used by the staff's schedule panel (KioskControlPanels.kt); overriding them changes that panel too.

Web mapping covers only the web keys the screens actually look up: unused LIVE keys (payBlockedTerminal, detailsTitle, nameLabel, nameHint, phoneLabel, phoneInvalid, tableLabel, tipTitle, tipNone, continue, notePlaceholder) and unused kiosks.preview keys (askTable, bonSent, notePlaceholder, name, table, tip, noTip) are not mapped. Preview sample data (sample.*, quickNote1-3 — the live kiosk passes the menu's own quick notes) and the editor's labels are out.

Web keys mapped by meaning to an Android slot with different wording: `confirmTitle` ("נוסף להזמנה", the skipCart=confirm sheet) → `added` ("נוסף לסל"); `clubScan` → `clubBody`; `search` (the search pill's placeholder) → `searchHint`; `empty` → `emptyCatalog`; `addMore` → `addMoreCta`; `close` (aria-label of every close button) → `kbClose`; `addToCart` + `upsellAddToOrder` → `addToOrder` (Android uses kapp_add_to_order for both).

Web-only keys: `allergensLabel` (the web writes "אלרגנים: " + list itself — 0 placeholders, Android's `kapp_allergens_chip` has 1, so they cannot share a key), `payCardOnly`, `payBlockedTitle` (Android titles a blocked payment with kalert_card_unavailable / kapp_pay_declined), `slipPrinted`, `receiptPrinted`, `resetsIn`, `openProduct`, `tickerLabel` (aria-label), `helpSent`, and three that appeared in the web sources while this was built: `stepSkip` (kiosks.preview, "דלג" on an optional service step), `tipChooseHint` (kiosks.preview, a required tip step) and `basketNewTotal` (LIVE, the basket-changed sheet). Android has no string for these yet.

The web sources (he.json, preview-screens.tsx, i18n.ts, KioskApp.tsx) were being edited while this was built; re-run the generator after they settle — it warns "WEB KEY NOT MAPPED" for any new `m.t()` / `t()` key the screens look up.

Open: `helpSent` ("קראנו לצוות…") matches Android `kalert_help_called` in strings_kiosk_alerts.xml, and the pay screen's card-lock title is `kalert_card_unavailable` — the kalert_* help / card texts are customer-facing but outside the six source files, so they are not in the registry.

Max: every legacy key was `TEXT_MAX` = 200 in the cloud; the registry's max is lower for most of them (titles 60, buttons 30, short labels 24, hints 100, at least 1.5× the longest default) — a saved config text longer than its new max would be refused if the cloud validates by the registry.

The Hebrew defaults of the legacy keys come from he.json `kiosks.builtin`: if the integration drops `kiosks.builtin`, re-running the generator falls back to the Android texts (the differences are in the table above).
Open: the web keyboard's aria-labels are hard-coded 'backspace' / 'shift' (preview-entry.tsx) — they could use `kbDelete` / `kbShift`.

Open: `quickAdd` (klay_quick_add) sits in layoutBasket as asked, but the quick "+" shows with `layout.quickAdd` (no_required / always) under any basket; a text-level shownWhen was not added because how a text's shownWhen combines with its group's is not defined.
